subject.title: feat(ui): group native session catalog rows by project in the sidebar

question: Should project grouping become the default after upgrade for every native session catalog rendered by this shared sidebar path?
rationale: The branch changes an existing default and applies through a generic renderer, while the discussion and proof primarily describe Codex and Claude fixture data.

options.title: Approve grouped default
options.body: Keep grouping enabled by default after confirming all catalog project keys and capturing real upgrade behavior proof.

options.title: Make grouping opt-in
options.body: Preserve the current flat layout when no preference exists and let users explicitly enable grouping.

options.title: Limit initial scope
options.body: Apply grouping only to catalogs with a confirmed canonical project identity and extend it later as provider contracts are proven.

recommendation.title: Approve grouped default
recommendation.body: Keep grouping enabled by default after confirming all catalog project keys and capturing real upgrade behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership routing and prior session/UI direction make this person the strongest available owner for the cross-catalog default decision.
